title: Curvature energy coercivity
question: For the regularized curvature functional in GC08, determine whether adding its squared integral to a fourth-order wave energy yields coercivity modulo symmetries.
first_test: Prove a lower energy bound or construct a bounded-energy escaping sequence.

title: Zero-amplitude phase defects
question: Classify when zeros of a complex wave prevent global phase reconstruction even if the regularized curvature remains bounded.
first_test: Construct a nodal counterexample or prove phase recovery under explicit nonvanishing conditions.

title: Vanishing-regularizer curvature limits
question: Determine the distributional limits of the GC08 curvature operator as its regularization epsilon tends to zero for fields with isolated vortices.
first_test: Identify possible defect measures and convergence topology.

title: Curvature and confinement on curved surfaces
question: Compare localized minimizers of a fourth-order wave energy on compact surfaces of different Gaussian curvature.
first_test: Prove geometric dependence of the lowest localized branch or its absence.

title: Anisotropic confinement thresholds
question: Determine how weak anisotropy in fourth-order dispersion shifts existence and stability thresholds for localized states.
first_test: Derive a first-order threshold expansion with uniform error control.

title: Curvature-induced spectral traps
question: Classify curvature-dependent effective potentials on a noncompact waveguide that support isolated bound states below a continuous band.
first_test: Prove a sufficient criterion and an optimal counterexample.

title: Localization under metric perturbations
question: Determine whether localized minimizers persist when the Euclidean metric is changed by a small compactly supported perturbation.
first_test: Establish variational convergence and stability of minimizers, or failure thereof.

title: Sharp curvature gradient inequality
question: Find the optimal constant in an inequality relating regularized phase curvature to amplitude and H2 norms on a specified domain.
first_test: Prove the sharp inequality or give a sequence invalidating it.

title: Quantitative confinement length scales
question: Determine whether a stable minimizer's concentration radius can be bounded above and below by explicit dimensionless parameters.
first_test: Prove two-sided bounds or exhibit parameter sequences with divergent width.

title: Domain geometry and edge confinement
question: Determine when boundaries of a smooth domain induce edge-localized fourth-order wave states absent in the whole-space model.
first_test: Classify a fixed boundary condition and prove an edge-mode existence or absence theorem.

title: Curvature closure selection by locality
question: Among rotation- and phase-invariant second-order curvature closures, determine whether locality and a fixed conservation law select a finite family.
first_test: Classify operators under stated axioms or exhibit an infinite remaining family.

title: Optimal confinement with fixed curvature budget
question: Given a wave energy and an upper bound on integrated curvature, determine the lowest possible localization radius at fixed mass.
first_test: Prove attainment or a sharp concentration obstruction.

title: Geometric confinement under weak disorder
question: Determine whether weak bounded variations of the curvature coupling preserve a ground-state localization region.
first_test: Establish perturbative existence with explicit disorder thresholds.

title: Regularized curvature and Sobolev continuity
question: Determine optimal Sobolev regularity for continuity of the GC08 curvature map between specified function spaces.
first_test: Prove local Lipschitz bounds or construct sequences violating them.

title: Multiple curvature wells and tunneling
question: For two separated geometric traps in a fourth-order operator, derive the asymptotic eigenvalue splitting and localized-mode tunneling rate.
first_test: Prove a splitting formula with separation-dependent remainder.

title: Vortex core energy lower bounds
question: Find sharp energy lower bounds for maps with prescribed winding and a regularized phase-curvature penalty.
first_test: Prove a winding-dependent bound or construct an unwinding path.

title: Local curvature data versus global confinement
question: Decide whether finite-radius curvature measurements can certify whole-space localization for a restricted wave model.
first_test: Construct indistinguishable localized and delocalized states or prove observability.

title: Dimensional threshold under constrained curvature
question: Determine how the critical dimensions for attained constrained minimizers change when a curvature-energy constraint is added.
first_test: Establish a dimension-dependent existence threshold or nonattainment construction.

title: Long-range geometric defects
question: Classify whether slowly decaying curvature perturbations create localized spectral modes or only threshold resonances.
first_test: Prove a decay-rate phase diagram for a specified defect family.
